notes.title: Museum Mystery is out in early access
notes.notes:
Happy early access game release day!

Museum Mystery will be distributed for free for some time. We would really appreciate your feedback: it will help us improve the game for the big release.

Check out our new trailer:
[previewyoutube=PKbqn55XW9o;full][/previewyoutube]

Have a great game, friends.

notes.title: Subscribe to Museum Mystery
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're Recently Played Games Studio, a tight-knit team working on a story-driven card roguelite game. And Museum Mystery is almost ready for launch!

We'll be keeping you in the loop with our updates here, but if you want to see more details or just support us, check out our social media:

Discord: https://discord.gg/qspDWkMu

Twitter: https://twitter.com/RecentlyPlayedG

You should expect to hear a lot more from us further on, so stay tuned.

[b]And don't forget to hit the Add to your wishlist and Follow button! It's important for small teams.[/b]
